The '''Tekdolian Languages''' are a branch of the [[Zhensanovian Languages]] associated in source material with the western highlands of the [[Union of Zhensanov]].

The source describes Tekdolian languages as having complex consonant clusters, ergative case alignment, tonal accent, directional verb prefixes, and a modified Cyrillic-derived alphabet.

== Canon Limits ==

This draft preserves Tekdolian as a linguistic branch only. It does not establish a province, nation, ethnic party, or historical state named Tekdolia.
